ctx.x: Yeah, so the Lion -- so he's saying, he got mad. He said who the hell is this guy? Who is he to tell me that? Said he was very mad. Willie kept playing, said the guys were blowing. If you can't play it, don't take it out here, you know. That's the way they was, Willie the Lion was.
So he started crying, saying Ah, so he took this horn out, put it back in the bag and went on home.
